author: Jason Stys
summary: Review authenticated candidate/active installed bytes and SPDX inventory under owned locking with state/trust/policy-bound non-executing receipts.
rationale: Supports offline release review without mistaking filenames or transfer completion for authenticity.
limitations: Operator/media aliases are assertions, not identity, physical-transfer proof or signatures.
Review does not execute payloads or grant activation permission.
Owned locks coordinate cooperating operations on a trusted filesystem, not a hostile administrator or arbitrary external writer.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
